note: The rhythm of Harr, on the host computer's clock. Scripted: at these times NemoWorld's director sends the listed residents to the listed place, and the chronicle records that it did. Nothing here is a fight, a hunt or a contest. `landmark_id` is a place the game server knows.

events.title: Market hour
events.blurb: Makers, farmers and couriers lay out what they have grown and made. Everyone may look, ask and share.

events.title: Story circle
events.blurb: Keepers and scholars read aloud what the village has learned and listen to anyone who wants to add a page.

events.title: Harr festival
events.blurb: Once a week the whole village gathers in the square to celebrate what has been built and found.
